video_title: Always Finding Ways To Improve: Film Study Pt.1 With Brandin Podziemski

quotes.speaker: Dustin
quotes.summary_phrase: Prioritizing missed shots over turnovers to increase offensive efficiency
quotes.excerpt: I would much rather this be a missed shot attempt than a turnover here.

text_blocks.speaker: Dustin
text_blocks.text: We talk all the time about missed shots over turnovers. I would much rather this be a missed shot attempt than a turnover here. And you know there's a good likelihood that you might even make that shot too. So just starting to take that risk more often, miss shot over turnover.

text_blocks.speaker: Brandin Podziemski
text_blocks.text: If I extend the arms there, it's a foul.

quotes.speaker: Dustin
quotes.summary_phrase: Maintaining the dribble to force defensive decisions and create gaps
quotes.excerpt: Putting KAT on an island, is he going to stay out and stay doubled?

text_blocks.speaker: Dustin
text_blocks.text: Again, we worked on it yesterday. Just keep our dribble alive more here. Putting KAT on an island, is he going to stay out and stay doubled? Or is he going to eventually leave and give you a gap to be able to attack again?

text_blocks.speaker: AC
text_blocks.text: What's the easier pass for you there B? To Post? Over the two with Karl? Or just swing it back?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandin Podziemski
text_blocks.text: I probably should just maybe take one more dribble here and then just jump in the air and look at and no be and just make him have to pick Gary or Quinten. And then he has to pick one of the two and whatever one he doesn't take, just throw it.

text_blocks.speaker: AC
text_blocks.text: Cause, Will is swinging on the backside. You've got nothing in front of you on the right. That's Will would seem to be the safer pass.

quotes.speaker: Dustin
quotes.summary_phrase: Taking aggressive shots to increase free throw attempt opportunities
quotes.excerpt: Those are the risks that I want you to take more of. Like take that shot.

text_blocks.speaker: Dustin
text_blocks.text: Those are the risks that I want you to take more of. Like take that shot. I'll live with the offensive foul. I'll live with a miss. But we're giving up a potential 84 points between the 42 turnovers that we have here. And obviously you're not going to make all of them. You're not going to shoot all of them. But when you talk about how we're going to make that leap, we know that it's going to be an increase in field goal attempts, specifically twos, because it's going to lead to more free throw attempts. So these are 42 times during the season that we didn't even give ourselves that chance.

quotes.speaker: AC
quotes.summary_phrase: Developing high-efficiency decision making and slowing the game down
quotes.excerpt: Simplifying the game to where you're at a highly efficient rate shooting, decision making.
quotes.quote: Simplifying the game to where you're at a highly efficient rate shooting, decision making. That's where they talk about players. The game is too fast for them. These are still some youthful mistakes.
